name: install-docs
body: Install documentation explains, in plain language for non-developers, how to install and upgrade kalide with no GitHub account, repo access or token: macOS via Homebrew (add tap `really-knows-ai/kalide`, `brew install kalide`, `brew upgrade kalide`), Windows via Scoop (add bucket `kalide`, `scoop install kalide`, `scoop update kalide`), and Linux — which has no package-manager channel — by downloading the matching `kalide-linux-<arch>` asset from the public GitHub Release, `chmod +x`, and running it; manual download is also documented as a fallback for macOS/Windows. INSTALL.md is the detailed guide; README.md's Install section is the front-loaded summary (see readme-install-front-loading). AC: following the docs on a clean machine of each supported OS, with no GitHub credentials, gets `kalide` installed or runnable; neither README.md nor INSTALL.md mentions creating/setting a GitHub token, `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN` or `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`, or requesting repo access.
